reviewKind: First independent DISPLAY visual-layout inspection of one bounded batch
reviewerScope: Fresh temporary image assistant; not a new permanent worker

included: Observable layout in the exact eight listed PNGs at their supplied native dimensions
Visible prose, question numbering, controls, formula typesetting and figure placement
Visible clipping, overlap, illegibility and error rendering
Explicit distinction between a supplied tile boundary and an observed product-layout defect
excluded: SCI, ZHEN, answer, choice and figure-substance revalidation
Source scans, old images and unlisted full-page backing screenshots
Mobile, other languages, other viewports and uncovered document regions
Control interaction, submission, live scroll reachability and current production verification
DOM, application database and Git operations
